upstream.drop_when: Replace this combined downstream integration only when Mu supplies the timer-frequency fallback, application-level event servicing, cancellable firmware UI and Shell, current-application ExitBootServices validation and boot-only NV protection. Verify navigation, reboot and DMA quiescence without the product hooks before removing their library dependencies.

Mu must provide a product-selectable USB mass-storage write prohibition that remains set after media changes and rejects writes before issuing any SCSI WRITE command. Verify hotplug, media-change and WriteBlocks paths preserve this policy before removing the downstream enforcement.

Remove when the selected Silicium DSC supplies compatible null bindings for the product event-pump and ExitBootServices libraries, or when their Basecore consumers are replaced together. Verify both the product binding and platforms using the null implementation still link.

The selected SecureBootHandler must process every newly reported filesystem, close each successfully opened root handle and release each notification buffer. Verify repeated filesystem scans leave no open volume preventing filesystem-driver unload.

Replace this combined SimpleInit integration when its selected source supports the Mu FDT and floating-point build interfaces, Chinese font and locale defaults, absolute-touch normalization, product-controlled navigation/reboot and an application-level GUI pump with snapshot cleanup. Verify menu input, return from Shell and safe Linux handover before removing the companion overlays.

SimpleInit must register keyboard, absolute-pointer and relative-pointer inputs even when initially absent, refresh handles after hotplug, serialize protocol reads against USB removal and release stale input state. Verify unplug during input, reconnect and Tab/Shift-Tab navigation without stale protocol calls.
